spots.name: Ronald E McNair Elementary School Murals
spots.blurb: You've reached Ronald E McNair Elementary School Murals, a mural. Street art changes fast, so if the wall has been repainted, look around: the next piece is often close by.

spots.name: California Landscape, Variation 1
spots.blurb: You've reached California Landscape, Variation 1, a mural by Ken Gonzales-Day from 2007. Gonzales-Day's photographic glazed tiles depict a pure unaltered landscape full of optimism and possibility. They might also suggest a dreamscape of quiet, calm and purity on which the viewer might play out his or her hopes for a better tomorrow.

spots.name: Pool
spots.blurb: You've reached Pool, a mural by Michele C. Martinez from 2008. Michele Martinez's large scale glazed ceramic tile murals on the pool house façade honor the park's namesake, Helen Keller. This panel shows a group of children basking in the sun alongside a rippling pool.
